experiment: report-only revision rerank with exact service/environment/operation scope gate
interface: real MCP stdio subprocesses for two writes and a later query; explicit scope and optional revision link
validation: Five probe tests, prior session-effect test and 37 MCP tests: 43 passed with a fresh dedicated pytest basetemp.
decision: Scope equality blocks the cross-environment false edge, but cannot establish that a same-scope draft is an effective correction. Reject production ranking change until an independently checkable revision assertion exists.
evidence_boundary: Four assistant-authored synthetic cases, no independent relation verdict or final answer model. All changes are report-only; no SDK/MCP defaults changed. Tool timings are single observations and exclude process startup, reviewer time and answer generation. No paid model calls.
